title: skill_report
$comment: CONTRACT SOURCE (canonical). The SHARED cross-skill unified output object emitted by every wired target-profile skill (assembled by _skills_common/skill_report.py::build_skill_report). This standalone file is the human-reviewable canonical definition + is meta-validated; the per-skill decision schemas do NOT $ref it across files — they EMBED it (via validators/gen_skill_output_schemas.py) into a self-contained monolith, matching house style and avoiding cross-file/network ref resolution. See docs/UNIFIED_OUTPUT_CONTRACT.md. Strict (additionalProperties:false) at the top level so any drift in the shared key set fails CI.

call.description: The verdict class (a skill-local enum, pinned per skill). null for a gateless (descriptive/inert) skill.

role.description: How the composer treats this skill. gating = verdict can move the nomination recommendation; descriptive = real read but no gate; inert = verdict-shaped string that is explicitly not a call.

polarity.description: One normalized direction on the canonical order-preserving scale (_skills_common/ordinal_view.py). descriptive/inert roles are not_scored. gating roles carry a DYNAMIC polarity (killer..supportive) — do NOT pin a polarity const on a gating skill.

honest_phrase.description: Reader-facing one-liner derived from the signal package; its polarity must agree with `call` (INV-7).

claim_chips.description: The A/B/C/D signal spine: per-axis {signal, corroboration, conflict} decoupled, each with role-tagged cites tracing to cards.

claim_scalars.description: Optional per-skill scalar claim fields that are not axis chips (e.g. tumor-presence homogeneity).

modality_scope.description: Per-modality (SM/degrader/ADC/TCE/antibody) signal record, or null for a modality-blind skill.

claim_chips_by_subtype.description: Within-pooled subtype sub-vector for target_report.subtype_convergence, or null.

evidence_graph.description: The claim-graph layer (build_evidence_graph). Attached onto the skill_report by the composer AND surfaced standalone; a named optional property so the composed skill_report validates against this strict spine (it is a render input the renderer reads off skill_report).

subgroup_signals.description: Per-subgroup signal bands (abundance/generality/…). Attached onto the skill_report by the composer; a named optional property (render input read off skill_report by report_render).

per_phase_metrics.description: Traceable numbers, each naming its sample_context + card_id (INV-3).

figures.description: The skill's hero + card plots, made selectable.

provenance.description: Audit: the driving rule, all fired rules, and the cards used vs missing.

_contract.description: Self-documenting contract-reference string stamped by build_skill_report.
